name: clean-architecture
description: Robert C. Martin's Clean Architecture as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for dependency direction, use cases, ports and adapters, component design and boundaries that keep business rules independent of frameworks and databases.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Clean Architecture rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
